entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Kaaf-Ha-Ya-'Ayn-Saad. (These are individual letters of the Arabic alphabet; Allah and His Messenger know their exact meanings.)
This is the mentioning of that Mercy of your Lord, which He bestowed upon His bondsman Zakariyya.
When he called his Lord softly.
He submitted, 'O my Lord, my bone has become weak and the flame of old age (i.e. grey hair) is shining from the head, and O my Lord, I have never been unsuccessful after calling You.'
'And I fear my relatives after me (that they may destroy the religion), and my wife is infertile; therefore, bestow upon me from Yourself such (an heir) who will take over my work.'
'He should be my successor and the heir of the children of Ya'qoob. And O my Lord, make him a cherished one.'
'O Zakariyya! We give you the glad tidings of a son whose name is Yahya. Before him, We have not made anyone of this name.'
He submitted, 'O my Lord, how can I have a son; whereas, my wife is infertile, and I have reached the state of thinness due to old age?'
He said, ‘It is exactly as so.' Your Lord said, 'That is easy for Me, and I have (indeed) created you before this, at a time when you did not exist.'
He submitted, 'O my Lord, give me some sign.' He (Allah) said, 'Your sign is this; that you will not (have the ability to) speak to people for three nights, (and) days, despite having good health.'
So, he came out to his people from the Mosque, and spoke to them through gestures that 'Keep glorifying (your Lord, in the) morning and evening.'
'O Yahya, hold on to the Book (i.e. the Tawrah) firmly.' And We gave him Prophethood in his childhood.
And compassion from Us, and purity; and he was extremely fearful (of Allah).
And was dutiful towards his parents, and was neither hostile nor disobedient.
And peace is upon him the day he was born, and the day he will pass away, and the day he will be raised alive.
And remember Maryam in the Book (i.e. the Qur'aan); when she went apart from her family to a place towards the East.
So, there she veiled from them, We henceforth sent Our Spiritual One (i.e. Jibra'eel) towards her; he appeared before her in the form of a healthy man.
She said, 'I seek refuge of the Most Gracious, from you; if you fear Allah.'
He said, 'I have been sent by your Lord, so that I may give you a pure son.'
She said, 'How can I bear a son? No man has touched me, nor am I unchaste.'

He said, 'It is only as so,' your Lord has declared that 'This is easy for Me.' And in order that We make him a sign for the people and (appoint him as) a mercy from Us; and this matter has been decreed (by Allah).
Now, Maryam conceived him, and she went away with him to a faraway place.
The pain of labour then brought her to the trunk of the date tree. She said, 'Oh, I wish I had died before this and had become (someone) totally forgotten.'
(The angel) therefore called her from underneath (the date tree); that 'Do not grieve; undoubtedly, your Lord has made a stream flow below you.'
'And grab the trunk of the date tree and shake it towards you; fresh ripe dates will fall upon you.'

'So, eat and drink, and keep your eyes coaol (because of your son); if you then see any person, so, say (with signs), “I have pledged a fast (of silence) for the Most Gracious, I will therefore not speak to any person today.”'
So, carrying him in her arms, she brought him to her people; they said, 'O Maryam, you have indeed done something very strange.'
'O sister of Haaroon! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother an unchaste woman.'
Thereupon, she pointed towards the child; they said, 'How can we speak to an infant who is in the cradle?'
The child ('Eisa) said, 'I am Allah's bondsman, He has given me the Book and made me a Conveyer of the unseen news (i.e. a Prophet).'
'And He has made me blessed; wherever I may be, and ordained upon me Salah and Zakah, for as long as I live.'
'And (He has made me) dutiful to my mother and has not made me hostile, unfortunate.'
'And that very peace (i.e. the same that was upon Yahya) be upon me the day I was born, and on the day I shall pass away, and on the day I will be raised alive.'
This is 'Eisa; the son of Maryam; a statement of truth, in which they (the Christians) doubt.
It does not befit Allah to take someone as His son; purity is to Him! When He orders anything, He just commands to it, 'Be,' and it becomes; instantly.
And said 'Eisa, 'Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord; therefore, worship Him; this path is straight.'
The groups then differed amongst themselves; so, destruction is for the disbelievers from the presence of a Great Day.
How much will they listen to and how much will they see on the Day when they will be present before Us, but today the unjust are in open error.
And warn them of the Day of regret when the matter would have been decided; and they are in negligence, and they do not believe.
Indeed, We shall be the Heir (i.e. the Owner) of the earth and whatever is therein, and only towards Us will they return.
And remember Ibrahim in the Book; indeed, he was Siddique (i.e. exceptionally truthful), a Conveyer of the unseen news (i.e. a Prophet).
When he said to his father (paternal uncle), 'O my father, why do you worship the one who neither hears nor sees, and cannot benefit you in any way?'
'O my father, indeed there has come to me that knowledge which did not come to you, therefore, follow me; I will show you the straight path.'
'O my father, do not be a bondsman of the Devil; indeed, the Devil is disobedient to the Most Gracious.'
'O my father, I fear that a punishment may reach you from the Most Gracious, you may consequently become a companion of the Devil.'
He (Aazar) said, 'What! Do you turn your face from my gods, O Ibrahim? If you do not desist, I will certainly stone you; and do not have any connection with me for a long time.'
He (Ibrahim) said, 'Enough! Salaam (i.e. goodbye to you). I shall soon seek forgiveness for you from my Lord (that He may grant you faith and thereafter forgive you). Indeed, He is very kind to me.'
'And I shall leave you alone and all those whom you worship other than Allah, and I shall worship my Lord; it is likely that by worshipping my Lord, I will not be amongst the unfortunate.'

Then, when he had alienated himself from them and whom they worshipped other than Allah, We bestowed upon him Is-haaq and Ya'qoob; and We made each of them a Conveyor of the unseen news (i.e. a Prophet).
And We bestowed upon them Our Mercy and assigned for them a truly prominent reputation.
And remember Moosa in the Book; he was indeed a chosen one, and he was a Messenger, a Conveyor of the unseen news (i.e. a Prophet).
We called him from the right side of Toor and brought him close, in order to reveal Our secret.
And out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Haaroon; a Conveyor of the unseen news (i.e. a Prophet).
And remember Isma'eel in the Book; he was indeed true in promise and was a Messenger, a Conveyor of the unseen news (i.e. a Prophet).
He used to command his family to offer Salah and give Zakah, and was pleasing to his Lord.
And remember Idrees in the Book; he was indeed exceptionally truthful, a Conveyor of the unseen news (i.e. a Prophet).
And We raised him to a high station.

It is these (bondsmen) upon whom Allah has bestowed favour from amongst the Conveyors of the unseen news (i.e. Prophets) from the descendants of Adam, and from those whom We caused to board along with Nooh and from the descendants of Ibrahim and Ya'qoob, and from those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they would fall down; prostrating and crying.

So, after them in their place came those unworthy successors who missed Salah and pursued their lusts; so, they will therefore soon encounter the jungle of Ghayy in Hell (i.e. a dreadful valley in the Hellfire).
Except those who repented and accepted faith and did good deeds; these people will therefore enter Paradise, and they will not be wronged at all.
Gardens of living, which the Most Gracious has promised to His bondsmen without them seeing (the Gardens); indeed, His promise is about to come.
They will not hear any vain talk therein, but only greetings of peace, and therein for them is sustenance; morning and evening.
This is that Garden, whose heir We shall appoint from Our bondsmen who is pious.

(And said the angel Jibra'eel to the Beloved Prophet) 'We, the angels, do not descend but by the command of the Lord of your respected self; only to Him belongs what is in front of us and what is behind us, and what is in between them; and the Lord of your respected self is never forgetful.'
(Only He is) the Owner of the heavens and the earth and what is between them; so, worship Him and be firm on His worship; do you know of any other of the same name as His?
And mankind says, 'When I will die, will I definitely be brought back alive soon?'
And does man not remember that We created him before this, and he was nothing?
So, by the oath of your Lord, We shall assemble them and the devils all together and bring them around Hell; fallen on (their) knees.
We shall then pick out from each group the one who will be the most daring towards the Most Gracious.
We know then very well those who are most deserving to be roasted in Hell.
And there is no one amongst you who shall not cross over Hell; this is inevitably a decided matter upon the responsibility (of the Generosity) of your Lord.
We shall then rescue the fearful ones and leave the unjust in it; fallen on their knees.
And when Our clear verses are recited to them, the disbelievers say to the Muslims, 'Which group has a better home and better company?'
And many generations We did destroy before them, that they were better in goods and splendour than them.

Say you (O Beloved), 'The one who is in error; so, the Most Gracious may give him enough respite until that time when they see that which they were promised; either the punishment or the Day of Judgement. So, they will now come to know for whom is the evil rank and whose army is weak?'
And Allah will further increase guidance for those who have attained guidance; and the ever-lasting good deeds have the best reward by your Lord, and the best outcome.
So, have you seen him who denied Our verses and says, 'I shall certainly be given wealth and children.'?
Has he glimpsed into the unseen, or has he made a pact with the Most Gracious?
Never. We shall now record what he says and give him an extremely prolonged punishment.
And it is only We Who shall inherit what he is mentioning (concerning his possessions), and he will come to Us alone.
And they have taken gods other than Allah, so that they may provide them with strength.
Never. Soon, they (i.e. the false deities) will deny their worshipping and will become opponents of them.
Did you not see that We sent devils upon the disbelievers; that they incite them excessively (to commit sins)?
So (O Beloved), do not hasten upon them, We are only completing their counting.
On the Day when We shall take the righteous people towards the Most Gracious as guests.
And will drive the culprits towards Hell; thirsty.
People are not the owners of intercession except those who have made a covenant with the Most Gracious.
And the disbelievers said, 'The Most Gracious has chosen offspring.'
You have indeed brought a speech of extreme limit (of evil).
It is near that the heavens may tear apart, and the earth may burst apart and the mountains may fall down, ruined.
That is because they ascribed offspring to the Most Gracious.
And it does not befit the Most Gracious to have offspring.
All those who are in the heavens and the earth will be present in His Majestic Court as bondsmen.
Indeed, He knows their number and has counted them one by one.
And each one of them will be present alone in His Majestic Court on the Day of Resurrection.
Indeed, those who believed and did good deeds; the Most Gracious will place love for them.
(O Beloved) We have henceforth made this Qur'aan easy upon your tongue; that you may give glad tidings with it to those who fear, and warn those who are quarrelsome.
And how many generations did We destroy before them; do you ever see any one of them or even hear their slightest sound?
